about: Codex session transcript study (2026-10-20). Structure-only: key names, value types, short enum vocabularies and counts read from ~/.codex on one Mac (python scripts that print shapes, never values), plus the openai/codex main-branch sources for semantics. No prompts, commands, paths, titles, branches or ids are reproduced; placeholders stand in for every value. Counts are from the whole local corpus unless a note says otherwise. Upstream main may be newer than the local builds (newest local rollout: 0.163.0-alpha).

versionsSeen.binaryOnPath: codex-cli 0.157.0 (codex --version). Rollouts are written by whichever client ran the thread, so the newest files (0.162/0.163 alpha, originator Codex Desktop) are newer than this binary: key behaviour off session_meta.payload.cli_version, never off the installed CLI.
versionsSeen.notes: 5233 rollout files, first record always session_meta. Many alpha builds (e.g. 0.162.0-alpha.17.2 is the single most common exact version, 640 files). The plain (uncompressed) .jsonl files are all 0.154-0.163.

corpus.notes: No thread was appending at study time: newest rollout mtime about 20 h old, while the desktop app was running (26 processes named like codex, ~/.codex/.codex-global-state.json and logs_2.sqlite-wal modified within 3 min). Liveness was therefore judged from file metadata and the recorder source, not by watching a file grow.

locations.notes: Directory date and filename timestamp are LOCAL time (5233/5233 filenames match session_meta time in the local zone; recorder uses OffsetDateTime::now_local for the path). In-record timestamps are UTC. <uuid> == session_meta.payload.id in 5233/5233 (first uuid of the name).

locations.notes: Locally: oldest plain file 8.9 d, newest .zst 8.1 d. Compression keeps mtime (sample of 150: p50 mtime - last record ts = 0.001 s). When a compressed thread is resumed the recorder decompresses it back to .jsonl before appending (materialize_rollout_for_append), so a .jsonl can reappear in an old date directory and the .zst vanish.

findings.count: 29 distinct groups over 4070420 lines.
findings.notes: No local_shell_call, no event_msg error/stream_error/exec_command_*/patch_apply_*/agent_reasoning/exec_approval_request anywhere. The rollout persistence policy explains it: in history_mode=paginated (5232/5233 files) only token_count, thread_goal_updated, thread_rolled_back, turn_aborted, task_started, task_complete, thread_settings_applied and item_completed are persisted from EventMsg; approvals, errors, warnings, PlanUpdate, ItemStarted, deltas and *_begin/*_end are transient (policy.rs). Old versions (0.40 ..) also show item_completed and ordinal, so those files were evidently rewritten into the paginated format by a migration (state_5 has rollout_migration_state / rollout_migration_skipped_rollouts tables; the mechanism is 미확인).

findings.example: line0 session_meta{subagent_history_start_ordinal: H} | ordinals 1..H-1 = inherited model context (may contain the parent's session_meta, compacted, response_item/compaction, messages) | ordinals >= H = this subagent's own turns
findings.count: Present in 4103 files (thread_spawn 1928/1948, guardian 2098/2171, review 77/77). Files with records after H (guardian 770, all 0.154+; spawn-fork 339): the pre-H records are written in a burst at birth (time after line 0: p50 0.0 s, p90 0.0 s) and H is small (guardian p50 2, spawn-fork p50 16). Files with no records after H (H == line count) 2990: spawn-nofork 875 (all < 0.154), spawn-fork 710 (< 0.154), guardian 1328 (186 of them 0.154+), review 77; there the pre-H block spans minutes (non-fork spawns p50 275 s) and holds the child's own task_started turns (875/875 non-fork).
findings.notes: Upstream doc: 'First rollout ordinal that belongs to this subagent's own projected history. Earlier rollout records are inherited model context and stay out of child turn/item projection.' Pre-H records never carried another thread_id in payload.thread_id (own id or none), so thread_id cannot detect inheritance; the ordinal can. Fork links: forked_from_id set in 1059 files and equals the spawn parent in 1053/1053; forked_from_ordinal_exclusive and history_base did not appear locally.

findings.example: append-only .jsonl, one line per record, flushed per line; compressed to .jsonl.zst after 7 days; decompressed back on resume
findings.count: 448/448 plain files: mtime - last record timestamp = 0.03 .. 5.76 ms (p50 0.56 ms). Newest file ~20 h old at study time, so growth was not observed live.
findings.notes: recorder.rs: files opened with append(true); JsonlWriter::write_line flushes after every line (no fsync); 'This file never truncates or rewrites in place'. A new thread's items can be held in pending_items until the rollout is materialized (persist), so a file may appear only after the first user input. Paths to watch: the date directory of today and yesterday (local time) for new files, plus any .jsonl reappearing in older directories (resume), plus _<uuid2> rollback segments.

mappingHints.session: One character per rollout file (thread). sessionId = session_meta.payload.id (== filename uuid; strip a '_<uuid2>' rollback suffix and treat the segment as the same session). agent = 'codex'. isSubagent = payload.source is an object with subagent.thread_spawn; parentSessionId = thread_spawn.parent_thread_id; agentType = agent_role (built-ins default|explorer|worker|awaiter, else scrubbed label). Skip or hide guardian reviewers (source.subagent.other == 'guardian', model codex-auto-review): 2171/5233 files. source.subagent == 'review' = /review runs (77).
mappingHints.cwdAndProject: project key from session_meta.payload.cwd (constant per thread here). Map ~/.codex/worktrees/<id>/<name> and <repo>/.worktrees|.claude/worktrees/<name> to their repo the same way as section 4.4 (for ~/.codex/worktrees the repo root is not in the path: fall back to git.repository_url basename or threads cwd; 미확인 best key). Subagents inherit the parent's project.
mappingHints.title: session_index.jsonl thread_name (latest per id) -> state_5 threads.name (read-only) -> first UserMessage text -> id prefix. Never threads.title (it is the first prompt).
mappingHints.branch: session_meta.payload.git.branch (null git -> null branch). Not updated during the thread in the rollout; threads.git_branch is the catalog copy.
mappingHints.prompt: Main threads: item_completed with item.type UserMessage: first content[].text; skip text starting with '<' (heartbeat, browser context, question replies, environment_context). Do not use response_item/message role=user (mixes AGENTS.md and tag-wrapped context). Ignore UserMessage in guardian threads. Spawned children (multi-agent v2): 0 own UserMessage items in 1948 thread_spawn files; the task arrives as response_item/agent_message (4331 own records; content[].type input_text, often plus encrypted_content) after inter_agent_communication_metadata, so child prompt = first own agent_message input_text (or the parent's spawn_agent arguments.message). In old/migrated child files the task is a UserMessage inside the pre-H block (4106).
mappingHints.toolStart: response_item function_call / custom_tool_call at the line where it appears (written before execution). toolUseId = call_id. Summary: exec_command.cmd / shell_command.command (string) or shell.command (argv) -> first program word; apply_patch input '*** Update|Add|Delete File: <path>' -> basename; MCP -> namespace/name masked per section 5; web_search_call.action.url host or query; request_user_input -> question/options. For code-mode 'exec' (>= 0.142.5) the input is a script: summarize as the first tools.<name> it calls, and optionally emit synthetic short tool_start/tool_end pairs for each inner item_completed CommandExecution (program from parsed_cmd[0] or argv[2] first word), FileChange (basename of changes keys), McpToolCall (server/tool), WebSearch (query or host).
mappingHints.toolEnd: function_call_output / custom_tool_call_output with the same call_id. ok unless: output head 'aborted by user' -> interrupted; 'rejected by user' / 'exec command rejected' / 'patch rejected' / 'approval required by policy' / 'sandbox denied' / 'failed in sandbox' -> denied; JSON metadata.exit_code != 0, 'Exit code: <n!=0>', 'Process exited with code <n!=0>', 'Script failed' / 'Script error:', '<tool> failed:' -> failed. 'Process running with session ID' -> ok with background: true. wait (code-mode cell polling, args cell_id) and write_stdin (args session_id) poll an already running exec/command: treat them as continuations (background) rather than new work. A call with no output when task_complete/turn_aborted for its turn arrives -> abandoned.
mappingHints.thinking: response_item reasoning: first non-empty summary[].text, else null (content and raw_content are never filled; encrypted_content is opaque). durationMs from the matching Reasoning item's completed_at_ms - started_at_ms when both exist, else null. Emit from one of the two duplicates only.
mappingHints.say: response_item message role=assistant, content[].type output_text (phase commentary or final_answer). Skip the duplicate AgentMessage item.
mappingHints.plan: update_plan arguments.plan[] {step,status} -> items {content: step, status} with source 'update_plan' (status enum identical). Plan item text and <proposed_plan> markdown -> planFromMarkdown (like exit_plan). Code-mode update_plan (>= 0.142.5) has no structured record: 미확인 whether to parse tools.update_plan({...}) out of the exec script.
mappingHints.question: request_user_input: question = questions[0].question (+N), options = questions[0].options[].label; ended by its output ({answers} -> ok). request_user_input_async and AgentMessage.questions(delivery async) are fire-and-forget questions.
mappingHints.turnEnd: task_complete -> turn_end reason end_turn; task_complete with error -> system kind api_error (error.message, scrubbed) then turn_end reason api_error; turn_aborted -> turn_end reason interrupt; a new task_started while the previous turn is open -> turn_end reason next_turn (787 cases). Turn start = task_started (turn_id).
mappingHints.subagents: Child files: own session_meta.source.subagent.thread_spawn.parent_thread_id. Skip records with ordinal < subagent_history_start_ordinal (inherited context) when that prefix is a birth-time burst; old migrated files set the value to the file length, so if skipping would leave nothing, fall back to reading everything after line 0. Parent side: SubAgentActivity kind completed|interrupted for agent_thread_id -> session_end done for that child; spawn_agent output gives agent_id/task_name. Depth up to 3.
mappingHints.errorsDenialsInterrupts: turn_aborted reason interrupted (887); task_complete.error {codex_error_info,message} (106); tool-level texts listed in toolEnd; item status failed/declined. No persisted API-error, warning or approval records.
mappingHints.compact: One system kind 'compact' per compacted record outside the inherited prefix; ignore response_item/compaction and the ContextCompaction item (same event).
mappingHints.liveTailing: Watch ~/.codex/sessions/<local YYYY/MM/DD>/rollout-*.jsonl (today and recent days) every 250 ms by byte offset; files are append-only and flushed per line, lines up to ~10 MB. Dedupe by ordinal (0-based line index; a rollback segment restarts at a lower ordinal and supersedes the tail). Read .jsonl.zst only for replay/history (needs zstd; node 20 zlib has no zstd). Handle a .jsonl disappearing (compression after 7 days) or reappearing (resume).
